command: set -e; echo BEFORE; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py status; echo DIAL; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py dial 510100100; active=0; for i in $(seq 1 30); do state=$(adb shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9]\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo poll=$i state=$state; if [ "$state" = "2" ]; then active=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; if [ "$active" != "1" ]; then echo CALL_DID_NOT_BECOME_ACTIVE; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py hangup || true; exit 3; fi; echo CAPTURE; mkdir -p /tmp/aicallbridge-live; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py capture 3000 /tmp/aicallbridge-live/autonomous-smoke.wav; ls -l /tmp/aicallbridge-live/autonomous-smoke.wav; echo UI_DUMP_ACTIVE; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py dump-ui | grep -Eo 'content-desc="[^"]+"|text="[^"]+"' | grep -Ei 'keypad|dialpad|klawiatura|end call|rozłącz|hang up|1|2|3' | head -n 80 || true; echo HANGUP; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py hangup; sleep 2; echo AFTER; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py status
